context: Evaluates correct implementation of the useDebounce hook from visionarias-client. The hook must use React's useState and useEffect to delay value propagation, correctly clear the timeout on each new value, and be generic over the value type.

checklist.name: useState for debounced
checklist.description: Uses React useState to store the debounced value as internal state

checklist.name: useEffect with delay
checklist.description: Uses React useEffect that sets a setTimeout to update the debounced value after the specified delay

checklist.name: Cleanup on change
checklist.description: useEffect returns a cleanup function that calls clearTimeout, preventing stale updates when value or delay changes

checklist.name: Dependency array
checklist.description: useEffect dependency array includes both value and delay so the timer resets on either change

checklist.name: Generic type parameter
checklist.description: Hook is typed with a generic type parameter <T> allowing use with strings, numbers, objects, etc.
